title: Diffusion Model in Latent Space for Medical Image Segmentation Task
abstract: arXiv:2512.01292v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Medical image segmentation is crucial for clinical diagnosis and treatment planning. Traditional methods typically produce a single segmentation mask, failing to capture inherent uncertainty. Recent generative models enable the creation of multiple plausible masks per image, mimicking the collaborative interpretation of several clinicians. However, these approaches remain computationally heavy. We propose MedSegLatDiff, a diffusion based framework that combines a variational autoencoder (VAE) with a latent diffusion model for efficient medical image segmentation. The VAE compresses the input into a low dimensional latent space, reducing noise and accelerating training, while the diffusion process operates directly in this compact representation. translated_title: 用于医学图像分割任务的潜空间扩散模型
translated_abstract: 医学图像分割对临床诊断和治疗规划至关重要。传统方法通常只生成单一的分割掩码，无法捕捉内在的不确定性。近期的生成模型虽然能够为每张图像生成多个合理的掩码，模拟多位临床医生的协同判读，但这些方法的计算开销仍然很大。我们提出了MedSegLatDiff，一种将变分自编码器（VAE）与潜空间扩散模型相结合的基于扩散模型的医学图像分割框架，可实现高效分割。VAE将输入压缩到低维潜空间中，降低噪声并加速训练，而扩散过程直接在该紧凑表示中进行。我们进一步将VAE掩码重建路径中传统的MSE损失替换为加权交叉熵损失，以更好地保留小结节等微小结构。MedSegLatDiff……
tldr: 提出了MedSegLatDiff框架，将VAE与潜空间扩散模型相结合以实现高效医学图像分割，并用加权交叉熵损失替代传统MSE损失，以更好地保留小结节等微小结构。
en_tdlr: Proposes MedSegLatDiff, a framework combining a VAE with a latent diffusion model for efficient medical image segmentation, replacing conventional MSE loss with weighted cross-entropy to better preserve tiny structures such as small nodules.
